text: and where do you live?” she said hurriedly in a breathless voice. He laid both hands on her shoulders and looked at her with a sort of rapture. It was such a joy to him to look at her, he could not have said why. “Who sent you?” “Sister Sonia sent me,” answered the girl, smiling still more brightly. “I knew it was sister Sonia sent you.” “Mamma sent me, too... when sister Sonia was sending me, mamma came up, too, and said ‘Run fast, Polenka.’” “Do you love sister Sonia?” “I love her more than anyone,” Polenka answered with a peculiar earnestness, and her smile became graver.
